sloka: ततः सीतामुपागम्य राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्छिताः ।परं परुषया वाचा वैदेहीम् इदमब्रुवन् ।। ५.२१.३।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sītāmupāgamya rākṣasyaḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ ।paraṁ paruṣayā vācā vaidehīm idamabruvan ।। 5.21.3।।।।

translations.english: "Turn your mind away from me and fix it on your wives. You should not expect to seek me just as a sinner cannot hope to seek blessedness.
